dev-s106a-classifier_off-violation.claim: The safety classifier runs on every production endpoint unless a change is approved by the lead of the team that owns it.

cast: Project Cinder (svc-387) is a production endpoint, serving Brightwater Health, owned by team delta
Project Kestrel (svc-413) is a production endpoint, owned by team harbor
Samuel Oyelaran is on team delta and leads no team

timeline.text: Change request CR-6336 to disable the classifier on Project Kestrel is approved by Dana Okafor
Change request CR-1976 to disable the classifier for deploy 6542 on Project Cinder is approved by Samuel Oyelaran
Deploy 6542 turns the safety classifier off on Project Cinder (production)
Monitoring shows Project Cinder serving with no safety classifier

story.verdict: Violation: deploy 6542 turned the classifier off on Project Cinder, a production endpoint, with no prior approval from the lead of team delta (CR-6336 approves a change to Project Kestrel, not Project Cinder; CR-1976 was approved by Samuel Oyelaran, who doesn't lead team delta).
story.reason: The classifier was switched off without the owning team's lead approving it: CR-6336 is for another endpoint; CR-1976 was approved by someone who leads no team.

chain.says: Deploy 6542's endpoint is the one in the ownership record
The owning team is the team in the org chart
CR-1976's approver is not the owning team's lead
CR-6336 is for a different endpoint
